text: {"assertions":["On 2026-02-17, a stale state bug in ui/state/cacheSlice.ts was fixed where old values persisted in the store snapshot after users edited records and navigated back to a list.","The stale state bug only manifested on the first request after a cold start.","The root cause of the stale state bug was an off-by-one error in the cache slice bound.","The stale state bug was fixed by correcting the slice bound and adding a property test to ui/state/cacheSlice.test.ts.","The stale state fix was submitted as PR #8748 on the fix/stale-state-1 branch.","After the stale state fix, cold start performance improved by 80 percent, with cold start time dropping to 881 ms.","The ui/state/cacheSlice.ts work involved the TypeScript web UI stack."]}
